item.title: The Quiet Challenge: Why Japan’s Kozo Tashima Wants to Lead FIFA
item.description: I have always admired the way Japanese football carries itself. Whether it is the players bowing to the crowd after a hard-fought match or the fans meticulously cleaning the stadium stands in Qatar or Russia, there is a sense of dignity that goes beyond the scoreline.
